item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p={'ignored':['skip']}; r={'declared':['b','a','b','skip','missing'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','name':'same','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','name':'same','hash':'2'},'b':{'hash':'x','kind':'file'},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'missing':{'kind':'missing'}}}; rb=copy.deepcopy(r); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); assert evaluate(r,p)=={'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}; assert r==rb and p==pb; data=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); expected=[evaluate(x,policy) for x in data]; actual=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected, (actual,expected); print('checks passed',actual)\"]}"}
